summary: Adaptation-only synthesis of the current 12-name T0 batch. No broad new research was launched. The highest-value handoffs are: ARM has enough primary evidence to move quantified SoftBank/control, related-party and customer-concentration facts to Chief review while leaving durability unknown; ASML's China/export-mix half is materially narrowed but critical-supplier concentration remains open; RKLB's liquidity/cash-burn and 2026 equity-financing picture is materially anchored but fully diluted capitalization, acquisition normalization and Neutron schedule/cash needs remain open; ANET still lacks a fresh filing-level concentration bridge and current substitution evidence; and discovery state contains one malformed symbol-directory footer pseudo-ticker that should be quarantined and parser-hardened before discovery can be considered clean.

targets.exactResearchQuestionGate: related-party economics, SoftBank/control governance and customer-concentration durability
targets.summary: The quantification portion of this gate is substantially closed by the prior Deep Runner artifact: SoftBank ownership/control, pledged-share exposure, top-five/Arm China concentration and related-party revenue/contract-asset economics are all grounded in current primary filings. The remaining blocker is durability/forward dependence rather than lack of present-state evidence.

findings.claim: Prior Deep Runner primary-source archaeology quantified SoftBank beneficial ownership at about 86.4%, with 769.029M shares / 72.0% of issued capital pledged, and documented enhanced governance rights and change-of-control risk.

FY2026 top-five customers represented about 57% of revenue; Arm China represented 16%; related-party revenue was $1.499B, and the June 2026 quarter included $192.9M of SoftBank-affiliate consulting revenue with about $577.2M of related contract assets.

Queue wording can be narrowed: current-state related-party/control/concentration quantification is no longer the main evidence gap; durability of those dependencies and unnamed customer identities remain the unresolved underwriting questions.

contradictions: Broad architecture adoption coexists with unusually concentrated monetization and controller/commercial-counterparty overlap.
unknowns: Durability of newer SoftBank-affiliate arrangements after initial terms.
Identity and persistence of unnamed 14% and 12% FY2026 customer buckets.
Realistic forced-sale/change-of-control probability from pledged SoftBank shares under stress.
falsifiers: Sustained decline in related-party revenue share with broad external royalty growth.
Material SoftBank ownership reduction accompanied by loss of enhanced governance rights.

targets.exactResearchQuestionGate: China/export mix and quantified critical-supplier concentration
targets.summary: The China/export-mix half is materially narrowed and should not be re-researched from scratch: China fell to 29.1% of 2025 sales and 14% of Q2 2026 net-system sales versus 19% in Q1, while export-license exposure remains structurally outside management control. The unresolved gate is quantified critical-supplier concentration/substitution lead time.

findings.claim: China represented 29.1% of 2025 total net sales versus 36.1% in 2024; Q2 2026 net-system sales by ship-to location were 14% China, 30% Taiwan and 43% South Korea.
ASML explicitly states EUV, specified DUV immersion and other products require export licenses whose criteria can change outside the company's control.

A static 2024-style China concentration penalty would overstate current observable revenue mix, but the structural policy-risk penalty remains valid. Supplier concentration must remain unknown until named critical suppliers, sole-source status or substitution lead times are quantified.

contradictions: Lower China mix reduces present geographic concentration while export-control optionality remains structurally material.
A large supplier count does not prove low dependence on technically irreplaceable modules.
unknowns: Named critical/sole-source supplier exposure by throughput, BOM value or substitution lead time.
Service/field-option versus new-system composition of current China exposure.
falsifiers: Primary supplier evidence showing qualified second sources for the highest-complexity modules with short substitution lead times.

targets.exactResearchQuestionGate: fresh filing-level loss/cash-burn, dilution/acquisition-accounting normalization and Neutron qualification/schedule risk
targets.summary: Do not repeat the cash-runway archaeology: Q2 2026 primary evidence already anchors $2.129B cash, $258.1M marketable securities, six-month operating cash use of $134.4M, and very large 2026 equity/forward financing. The unresolved work is fully diluted denominator reconciliation, acquisition purchase-accounting normalization, and a source-grounded Neutron qualification/schedule/cash requirement bridge.

findings.claim: At June 30, 2026 Rocket Lab reported $2.129B cash plus $258.1M marketable securities while six-month operating cash use was $134.4M and investing cash use was $84.6M.

The first six months of 2026 included about $1.53B gross common-share issuance across two distribution agreements plus collared forwards covering 7.451M shares with about $474M-$642M expected proceeds around 2028 maturities.

Near-term liquidity is strong, but it should not be scored as internally generated financial strength because financing inflows materially exceed operating burn. Capital-survival and dilution must be separated.

contradictions: Large liquidity coexists with continued cash burn, acquisitions and explicit financing dependence.
Neutron progress exists but qualification and first-flight economics remain unresolved.
unknowns: Fully diluted denominator without double-counting ATM shares, employee awards, preferred conversion and forward-settlement mechanics.
Neutron probability-weighted schedule and remaining program cash need.
falsifiers: Material Neutron qualification failure or schedule reset that raises capital needs.
Additional in-the-money or acquisition-linked instruments materially increase effective dilution beyond the current bridge.

targets.exactResearchQuestionGate: filing-level large-customer concentration and white-box/custom-network substitution evidence
targets.summary: This gate remains genuinely open. Same-cycle red-team evidence confirms the economic relevance of Microsoft/Meta-style concentration and proprietary/white-box substitution, but the cited filing is historical and does not close the queue's request for fresh filing-level customer concentration or current 1.6T/XPO buyer breadth. Adaptation mode therefore hands this forward rather than relabeling historical evidence as current.

findings.claim: Same-cycle red-team review identifies cloud-titan concentration and proprietary/white-box architecture substitution as the core failure path, supported by Arista issuer materials and an SEC filing.
Because the concentration evidence cited by the red-team is not a fresh 2026 concentration footnote, it is sufficient to preserve the risk thesis but not sufficient to close the T0 underwriting gate.

contradictions: Excellent networking execution and open-Ethernet growth can coexist with high dependence on a few hyperscaler architecture/procurement decisions.
unknowns: Current top-customer percentages from the freshest filing.
Quantified white-box/custom-fabric substitution rate or share displacement.
falsifiers: Fresh filings show material customer diversification while new AI-fabric platforms scale across multiple independent buyers.

targets.exactResearchQuestionGate: discovery integrity: malformed symbol-directory footer pseudo-ticker must not remain canonical
targets.summary: Latest same-cycle discovery repair found `FILE CREATION TIME: 0914202603:02` persisted as a discovery-pool pseudo-ticker with blank company/exchange. This is feed metadata contamination, not a security. It should be quarantined through Chief/source-integrity and the parser should reject all File Creation Time footer variants. This is an integrity cleanup, not a company admission or score change.

findings.claim: The same-cycle discovery lane explicitly identified the malformed pseudo-ticker in data/runtime/discovery-pool.json and traced it to the official symbol-directory footer pattern.
Endpoint health and machine discovery completion do not prove parser cleanliness; source-integrity should treat this as a deterministic parser/data-hygiene defect.

contradictions: The symbol-directory source is reachable/healthy while its persisted derived state contains malformed footer metadata.
unknowns: Whether prior discovery snapshots contain additional footer/header contamination variants.
falsifiers: A canonical parser inspection demonstrates this row came from a valid security record rather than footer metadata; current evidence strongly argues otherwise.

ASML current China/export mix archaeology already captured from 2025 annual report and Q2 2026 materials.
RKLB Q2 2026 liquidity, six-month cash burn, ATM issuance and collared-forward financing quantification.
Batch-wide common-mode hyperscaler AI-capex risk already identified independently by red-team, structural-causal and expectations-execution lanes.
